entities.summary: Nile TV International is an Egyptian satellite television news network. It is the first Arab satellite channel to broadcast its programs in foreign languages; English, French, and formerly Hebrew. Nile TV International broadcasts via four satellites, allowing its broadcast to reach the entire Arab world, the Middle East, Europe, and the United States.
